requirements.R_PACKAGE: Node.js CDK package exposes package.json, bin/synth.js, and lib/network-fabric.js with pinned CDK dependencies
requirements.R_VPC: VPC DNS, stable tags, secondary IPv4 CIDR, IPv6 association, and required outputs
requirements.R_SUBNETS: public/private/database/intra subnets across AZs with tags and IPv6 assignment
requirements.R_NAT: per-AZ, single-NAT, and disabled-NAT routing semantics
requirements.R_ENDPOINTS: gateway/interface endpoints and endpoint security-group scoping
requirements.R_ACL_FLOW: tier-specific NACLs and least-privilege VPC flow logs
requirements.R_VALIDATION: fail-before-synthesis validation for invalid CIDR, endpoint, and NAT inputs
requirements.R_DETERMINISM: identical input produces identical synthesized template content
